result.description:
The Company

At Comunet, we love great tech—but what really drives us is what it makes possible. For 30 years, we’ve been helping organisations get more from their IT, whether that means tightening security, modernising legacy environments, reducing complexity, or setting them up for what’s next. We work with smart people, solve real problems, and build technology that genuinely makes life easier for our clients.? 

We’re big on curiosity, initiative, and people who genuinely enjoy figuring things out. We like teammates who can dive into a technical challenge, collaborate well, share what they know, and still keep things light along the way. Culture matters here, and we invest in it—with a strong Employee Value Proposition, Friday drinks, team events, whole-of-business catchups, and a fully stocked pantry. We work hard, support each other, and make sure there’s room to grow, experiment, and enjoy the ride.? 

We invest in our people through certified and flexible training, flexible work options, and strong support structures. We also believe in promoting from within and take pride in seeing our people grow and succeed. 



About the Role

The Support Engineer role at Comunet is not an entry-level position—it’s for someone who already has solid runs on the board and enjoys getting stuck into complex technical problems. You’ll be a key escalation point within our support team, taking ownership of issues across networking, cloud, security, infrastructure, and more. We’re looking for someone who can work with confidence, think critically, and bring the kind of hands-on experience that helps solve the tougher challenges when they land. 

At its core, this role is about keeping client and internal environments secure, stable, and performing at a high standard—but it also comes with real responsibility. This is a role for someone who can operate with a fair degree of autonomy, make sound technical decisions, and contribute meaningfully across both BAU support and project work. You’ll also help guide graduate and entry-level team members, share your knowledge, and lift the capability of the wider team through experience, mentorship, and technical leadership. 

We operate 6am - 6pm Monday to Friday to service our clients and shifts will fall within these hours on a rotating basis. 

 Applicants must have the legal right to work in Australia on an ongoing basis. 



Key Responsibilities:

Deliver high-quality IT support to our clients, with a strong focus on responsiveness, professionalism, and customer service. 

Provide guidance and mentoring to IT Support Analysts, interns, and other junior team members, helping build technical capability across the team. 

Manage support tickets effectively, ensuring client requests are accurately logged, updated, prioritised, and progressed through to resolution. 

Deliver remote and phone-based support for escalated and technology-specific issues across a broad range of client environments. 

Contribute to onsite support activities and assist with project delivery, technical implementations, and other assigned tasks as required. 

Maintain, patch, monitor, and upgrade IT environments to support reliability, performance, and security outcomes. 

Ensure work is tracked in timesheets for client services and personal development activities. 

Support and administer core IT infrastructure and cloud-based systems, applying strong technical skills across modern business environments. 



 Key technical skills:

Knowledge of basic networking (routing and switching). 

2+ years of experience in Windows Server Administration. This is expected to include familiarity with Active Directory, Group Policy, and management of common server roles. 

2+ years of experience in Microsoft 365 administration (with exposure to hybrid Exchange environments considered highly desirable). 

AWS and/or Azure skills highly desirable. 

Demonstrate a strong knowledge of security practises and controls. 



Attributes we look for:

You’ll bring at least two years of IT experience, along with relevant qualifications or certifications, and be ready to build on your existing knowledge. You’ll enjoy working with clients to solve technical challenges and help deliver stable, secure, and reliable platforms for their business. 



How to Apply

We'd love a cover letter with your CV addressing why you should be the suitable candidate to join us. 

As this is active ongoing recruitment process the position may be filled with the right applicant before the published closing date - so we encourage applications as early as possible.  

By submitting an application to Comunet, you acknowledge that we will undertake workforce screening activities including, but not limited to: Reference checks, National Crime and Right to Work Checks, Identity and certification verification.

Only candidates that are short listed will be contacted.

result.description:
We are looking for an experienced and driven ICT Project Manager to lead the planning, execution, and delivery of technology projects across our organisation. The successful candidate will bring strong leadership capabilities, a solid understanding of ICT systems and infrastructure, and a proven ability to manage competing priorities within budget and timeline constraints. This role suits a results-oriented professional who thrives in dynamic environments and can effectively bridge technical and business stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities
Plan, organise, and oversee end-to-end delivery of ICT projects, ensuring milestones, objectives, and deliverables are met within agreed timeframes and budgets
Analyse organisational information needs and specify appropriate technology solutions to address those requirements effectively
Formulate and contribute to ICT strategies, policies, and plans that align with broader business goals and digital transformation initiatives
Direct the selection, procurement, and installation of ICT resources, including software, hardware, and infrastructure, and coordinate relevant user training programmes
Manage project resources, scheduling, and task prioritisation, allocating team members and contractors to maximise efficiency and project outcomes
Set priorities across system development, maintenance, and operational activities, balancing short-term demands with long-term strategic objectives
Oversee the security and integrity of ICT systems, ensuring compliance with organisational policies, data governance frameworks, and relevant legislative requirements
Identify, assess, and manage project risks and issues, implementing mitigation strategies and escalating where necessary to ensure continuity of delivery
Develop and maintain comprehensive project documentation, including project plans, status reports, risk registers, and post-implementation reviews
Liaise with internal stakeholders, vendors, and third-party service providers to manage expectations, resolve impediments, and maintain clear lines of communication throughout the project lifecycle
Monitor project budgets, track expenditure, and provide regular financial reporting to senior leadership and governance committees
Champion continuous improvement by conducting lessons-learnt reviews and embedding better practices across the project delivery function
Required Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor's degree or higher in Information Technology, Computer Science, Project Management, or a related discipline
Demonstrated experience (typically 3–5 years) managing ICT projects of varying scale and complexity within a corporate or government environment
Proficiency in project management methodologies such as PMBOK, PRINCE2, or Agile/Scrum frameworks
Strong understanding of ICT infrastructure, software development lifecycles, systems integration, and enterprise technology environments
Proven ability to manage budgets, resource plans, and project schedules using tools such as MS Project, Jira, or equivalent platforms
Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences
Sound analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a structured approach to risk and issue management
Experience preparing and presenting project governance documentation, business cases, and status reports to senior leadership
Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage vendor relationships effectively
Knowledge of cybersecurity principles, data privacy obligations, and relevant Australian regulatory frameworks
Preferred Qualifications
PMP (Project Management Professional) or PRINCE2 Practitioner certification
ITIL Foundation certification or experience working within ITIL-aligned service environments
Experience delivering projects within Agile or hybrid delivery models
Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud
Experience in change management practices and supporting organisational technology transitions
Exposure to enterprise resource planning (ERP) or large-scale system implementation projects
Prior experience working within highly regulated industries such as finance, healthcare, or government
Why Join Us?
Flexible working arrangements, including hybrid and remote options, supporting a healthy work-life balance
Ongoing professional development opportunities, including funded certifications, training programmes, and industry conference access
A collaborative and inclusive workplace culture that values innovation, continuous improvement, and diverse perspectives
Access to an employee benefits programme including wellness initiatives, additional leave options, and corporate discounts
Meaningful work contributing to impactful technology projects that drive real organisational and community outcomes
Job Details
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

result.description:
Cox Purtell  
  Senior Salesforce System Administrator  
 You know Salesforce is only as strong as the way it is looked after. 
 Clean access. Sensible configuration. Stable releases. Good support. Strong governance. A platform people can actually rely on. 
 That is what this role is about. 
 You'll be joining a Brisbane-based university using Salesforce across existing and new platforms, including CRM, Marketing and Education Cloud. Some of the environment is established. Some of it is being improved and remediated. Your role will be to help look after the whole platform, not just one narrow part of it. 
 This will suit you if you are a hands-on Salesforce Administrator who likes ownership, cares about platform quality, and enjoys being close to the people who use the system. 
  The role  
 As the Senior Salesforce System Administrator, you'll help keep Salesforce stable, secure and useful across a large university environment. 
 You'll work across day-to-day administration, user support, configuration, platform improvement, release support and governance. 
 You'll be the person helping make sure Salesforce is well managed across CRM, marketing, engagement, alumni-style use cases and Education Cloud. 
 You'll work with the Salesforce Program Manager, architects, business analysts, DevOps specialists and business stakeholders. You won't be working in isolation, but you will be trusted to take real ownership of the admin layer of the platform. 
  What you'll be doing  
 You'll manage Salesforce users, roles, profiles, permission sets, licences and access controls. 
 You'll support Salesforce CRM, Marketing and Education Cloud usage across existing and new platform areas. 
 You'll provide practical support to users, helping resolve issues and improve how teams use Salesforce. 
 You'll configure Salesforce using declarative tools such as Flow, Approval Processes, Assignment Rules, Lightning pages, page layouts and permission structures. 
 You'll support sandbox management, release management and controlled deployment processes. 
 You'll help identify technical debt, platform risks, security issues and improvement opportunities. 
 You'll document changes, support adoption and create guidance that helps users get better value from Salesforce. 
 You'll help improve and remediate the platform while also keeping the current environment running properly. 
  What we're looking for  
 You'll bring strong hands-on Salesforce administration experience. 
 You might currently be a Salesforce Administrator, Senior Salesforce Administrator, Salesforce System Administrator, Salesforce Platform Administrator or Salesforce Consultant with strong admin capability. 
 Higher education experience would be useful, but it is not essential. 
 Experience in adjacent environments would be very relevant, particularly CRM, marketing, membership, alumni, engagement, customer service or stakeholder management platforms. 
 You'll be comfortable working in a complex Salesforce environment where different teams use the platform in different ways. 
 You'll understand Salesforce security, user access, profiles, permission sets, configuration, support and release processes. 
 Salesforce Administrator certification is preferred. If you are not certified yet but are actively working towards it, we are still happy to talk. 
  Why this role could be interesting  
 You'll have genuine ownership of a high-impact Salesforce platform. 
 You'll be involved in both improvement and remediation, not just routine ticket work. 
 You'll work across broad Salesforce use cases, including CRM, Marketing and Education Cloud. 
 You'll be part of a major university environment where Salesforce supports real engagement with students, staff, partners and alumni. 
 You'll have the chance to help create a strong higher-ed Salesforce case study. 
  Location  
 The university is based in Brisbane. 
 Brisbane-based candidates are very welcome and would spend regular time in the office. 
 We can also consider candidates in Sydney, Melbourne or other eastern Australian cities, provided you are willing to travel to Brisbane occasionally. As a guide, there will be an expectation to attend the Brisbane office at least once per month. 
  Work rights  
 We can only consider candidates with full work rights in Australia. 
 You will need to be an Australian citizen, Australian permanent resident or New Zealand citizen. 
  Key details  
 Role: Senior Salesforce System Administrator Platform: Salesforce CRM, Marketing and Education Cloud Contract: 12-month fixed term contract, likely to extend Package: $160,000 plus superannuation Location: Brisbane preferred; Sydney, Melbourne and other eastern Australian cities considered Work rights: Australian citizen, Australian permanent resident or New Zealand citizen only 
  Interested?  
 Apply with your CV or get in touch for a confidential conversation. 
 This is a strong role if you want to own, improve and support a Salesforce platform that matters.
